text:
La startup Clarity recrute activement sur Paris en ce moment
<https://clarity-technologies.com/>

Le détail des offres ci-dessous
___

Hi everyone! I wanted to share some <https://clarityhealth.notion.site/Clarity-Open-positions-5df822772fd64190b027f8492753b895|job offers> that we are just opening at Clarity in Paris. We look for passionate people to help us build our platform and digital therapeutics for people undergoing neurological disorders.
It is the perfect opportunity to have a significant impact and build something meaningful for millions of people.

We look for talents in <https://clarityhealth.notion.site/Clarity-Open-positions-5df822772fd64190b027f8492753b895|neurotech, software engineering, product design, VR software engineering, electrical engineering, and data science>.

Here are the top 3 patterns we are looking for:
1) Emotional maturity and having lived strong experiences in his/her life
2) Deep drive for solving brain health issues
3) High ability to execute and build

If you feel that an offer aligns with you, please apply! Thank you
